## What would you like to do?
- [ ] Propose or list a community integration (free)
- [ ] Discuss sponsored placement
- [ ] Commission integration development or maintenance

## Integration
What does it connect to Go Micro, and who is it useful for?

## Repository and maintainer
Source URL, maintainer/contact, license, and supported Go Micro versions.
For a new proposal, describe what you plan to build.

## Usage and verification
Link installation instructions, a working example, and integration tests if available.

## Scope
For sponsorship or paid work, describe the placement or work you need and your timeline.

Community contributions do not require sponsorship. Sponsorship does not guarantee acceptance into core or maintenance by Micro. Vendor-specific implementations should live in their own repositories.
